episodeTitle.en: Building high-performing teams | Melissa Tan (Webflow, Dropbox, Canva)
episodeTitle.zh: 打造高效团队 | 梅利莎·谭（Webflow、Dropbox、Canva）

guestBioOfficial.en: Melissa Tan is an advisor, investor, and growth expert. She’s worked with fast-growing startups like Dropbox, Canva, Grammarly, and Miro, and for the past 2.5 years has been the Head of Growth at Webflow. There, she led the company's self-service business across Product, Marketing, and Growth, in addition to leading the charge on pricing and packaging. Prior to Webflow, she was Head of Growth for Dropbox’s B2B product, where she played a pivotal role in propelling their growth. In today’s episode, we discuss: • Attributes of high-performing teams
guestBioOfficial.zh: 梅利莎·谭是一位顾问、投资者和增长专家。她曾与Dropbox、Canva、Grammarly和Miro等快速成长的初创公司合作，过去两年半一直担任Webflow的增长部门负责人，负责产品、营销和增长部门的自助服务业务，同时主导定价和套餐策略。在加入Webflow之前，她曾担任Dropbox B2B产品部门的增长负责人，为推动该部门增长发挥了关键作用。在本期节目中，我们将探讨：• 高效团队的特质

title.en: Building high-performing teams | Melissa Tan (Webflow, Dropbox, Canva)
title.zh: 打造高效团队 | 梅利莎·谭（Webflow、Dropbox、Canva）

summary.en: Melissa shares how hiring smart people with no sales background at Dropbox led to unexpectedly innovative go-to-market motions. She champions first-principles thinking over copying playbooks. The episode offers grounded growth advice drawn from scaling one of the most iconic B2B products.
summary.zh: 梅丽莎分享了在 Dropbox 雇佣毫无销售背景的聪明人，反而催生出意料之外的创新获客打法。她推崇"第一性原理思考"，而非照搬套路。本期提供了来自打造最具标志性 B2B 产品之一的扎实增长建议。
